notes.title: Patch bugs/mode change
notes.content:
-Bug fix in the four way spawner in destroy method.
-Bug fix in guns reverting to shmup mode given an unusual condition.
-Turned Timed mode into "hard mode"

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: A bug was found sometimes turning off the headache reduction when boosting.

notes.title: Patch LOD
notes.content: LOD levels added to hourglass, desert part 2, replacement obj's.

notes.title: Patch Hud/Gears/Cards/Tut
notes.content: Color coordination added to HUD and cards, removed unnecessary gears thanks to feedback, higher headache (previously heat) tolerance adjustment. Tutorial maintenance.

notes.title: Patch Cursor / Platypus
notes.content: The cursor hotspot was misaligned. The center is now corrected. Added platypus count.

notes.title: Time Tower Replacement
notes.content: Several commentors said they thought the towers were unprofessional and tacky. They've been replaced.

notes.title: Revolver Patch
notes.content: Gimbal locking in the revolver resulted in a switch to quaternions instead of euler angles.

notes.title: Base stats change.
notes.content: A number of base stats have been updated based on feedback.

notes.title: Difficulty Reduction
notes.content: Difficulty reduced In early waves.

notes.title: List Cleanup
notes.content: Some players reported notable frame drops on the flock spawns. The problem was related to list searches instead of direct refs being used. Patch applied.

notes.title: Portal FX patch 1
notes.content: Comment from youtube add entrance animations! I thought this was a great point.

notes.title: Weapons Configuration
notes.content: After much hilarious debate. ;) Shmup style controls will be included, it's now optional for fps style controls or shmup from the opening screen.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Bug in the tutorial menu, thank you for report!

notes.title: Last Patch! And Thank you to everyone!
notes.content: Last patch of this version, thanks to everyone who provided feedback and support! I am truly grateful!
